Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Fri Jun 5 10:10:29 2026 -0700
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Fri Jun 5 10:10:29 2026 -0700

    Bug 2038897 - Port bug 2030946: Trigger missing Jobs should ignore DONTBUILD/optimizations release branches. r=coreycb
    
    
    Port https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/rev/987d49f6c5a7
    
    Like https://searchfox.org/firefox-main/rev/fc12c6f52aea47b9ca635b0ab71315ffbeb8c2f9/taskcluster/gecko_taskgraph/decision.py#405-411
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D304661

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/decision.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/decision.py
index d7b2b5ce56c..10df80792e6 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/decision.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/decision.py
@@ -155,11 +155,12 @@ def get_decision_parameters(graph_config, parameters):
     if options.get("target_tasks_method"):
         parameters["target_tasks_method"] = options["target_tasks_method"]
 
-    # ..but can be overridden by the commit message: if it contains the special
-    # string "DONTBUILD" and this is an on-push decision task, then use the
-    # special 'nothing' target task method.
-    if "DONTBUILD" in commit_message and options["tasks_for"] == "hg-push":
-        parameters["target_tasks_method"] = "nothing"
+    # If the commit message contains "DONTBUILD" and this is an on-push
+    # decision task, mark it so the morph phase can drop all tasks and so
+    # that is_backstop knows not to count this push as a backstop.
+    parameters["dontbuild"] = (
+        "DONTBUILD" in commit_message and options["tasks_for"] == "hg-push"
+    )
 
     del parameters["backstop"]
     parameters["backstop"] = is_backstop(
diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/test/test_parameters.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/test/test_parameters.py
index f7ef036cdad..cdb14950f32 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/test/test_parameters.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/test/test_parameters.py
@@ -29,6 +29,7 @@ class TestCommParameters(unittest.TestCase):
         "comm_head_rev": "comm_head_rev",
         "comm_src_path": "comm/",
         "do_not_optimize": [],
+        "dontbuild": False,
         "enable_always_target": False,
         "existing_tasks": {},
         "files_changed": [],
diff --git a/taskcluster/test/params/update.sh b/taskcluster/test/params/update.sh
index af2e4dfd3d2..5521cc545c6 100755
--- a/taskcluster/test/params/update.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/test/params/update.sh
@@ -52,7 +52,8 @@ for f in "${files[@]}"; do
             while :; do
                 params=$(curl -f -L "${TASKCLUSTER_ROOT_URL}/api/${service}/v1/task/${task}/artifacts/public%2Fparameters.yml")
                 method=$(echo "$params" | yq -r .target_tasks_method)
-                if [ "$method" != "nothing" ]; then
+                dontbuild=$(echo "$params" | yq -r .dontbuild)
+                if [ "$method" != "nothing" ] && [ "$dontbuild" != "true" ]; then
                     break
                 fi
                 pushlog_id=$(echo "$params" | yq -r .pushlog_id)
